items.text: Bounded retries, streaming responses and trace context make the path production-ready.

Gateway validates identity, quota and request schema.

Services retrieve context and invoke allowed tools.
Stream output and record usage, latency and trace.
One trace ID spans the gateway, orchestrator, tool calls and model response.
